Import / Export

CSV files open in Excel. For import, save your Excel worksheet as CSV UTF-8 (Comma delimited). This standalone file does not directly read native .xlsx files.

CSV import requires HospitalName, District and GONumber. HospitalID is optional; imported profiles are not automatically created in the Hospital Directory. The imported G.O. number is matched to G.O. Master by exact number; unmatched G.O. references are retained as text in the hospital record and flagged for correction.

Backup: JSON backup includes hospital records and all four masters (district, cluster, speciality and G.O.). Keep a copy in an approved secure location.
